newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $979 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $979 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, July 31 were expected to total $979 million in 16 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $761 million in five sales, with a $640 million E 470 Highway Authority, Colo., offering through Lehman Brothers topping the list.
On the competitive side, 11 sales totaling $218 million were scheduled. A $101 million Wisconsin offering at 1100 EDT was the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $16 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
